title: Internal Sales, Leeds
description:
Join ASD and Accelerate Your Sales Career

At ASD, we are one of the UK's leading metal stockholders and processing specialists, supplying high-quality steel and metal products to customers across a wide range of industries. Built on expertise, innovation and long-term partnerships, we help our customers succeed while driving positive change for our colleagues, communities and the environment.

If you enjoy building relationships, delivering excellent customer service and growing sales, this is an opportunity to develop your career with a market leader.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an ambitious and commercially driven Internal Salesperson to join our team.

This fast-paced, customer-focused role involves managing customer accounts, responding to enquiries, preparing quotations and identifying opportunities to grow profitable sales. You will build long-term customer relationships, understand their requirements and provide the right products and solutions, working closely with customers and our External Sales team to develop accounts and win new business.

This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated sales professional who thrives in a busy commercial environment.

Hours: 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday. Office-based at our Leeds site (LS10 1 SD).

What You'll Be Doing
- Managing and developing existing customer accounts
- Responding to enquiries and preparing accurate, competitive quotations
- Building relationships through regular telephone and email contact
- Identifying opportunities to increase sales and account profitability
- Following up quotations and converting opportunities into sales
- Working with External Sales colleagues to develop accounts and win new business
- Providing excellent customer service and resolving queries efficiently
- Developing account plans to maximise sales opportunities
- Maintaining accurate customer records and CRM activity
- Monitoring market trends, competitor activity and new opportunities
- Supporting account management and credit control activities where required
- Achieving agreed sales, margin and customer growth targets

What We're Looking For

We are interested in candidates with the drive, resilience and commercial awareness to succeed in sales.

Ideally, you will have:
- Experience in internal sales, customer service, account management or sales support
- Experience in metals, industrial, manufacturing or distribution sectors (preferred but not essential)
- The ability to build customer relationships and identify sales opportunities
- Strong commercial awareness and a target-driven approach
- Excellent communication, negotiation and influencing skills
- Confidence working with figures, margins and commercial data
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities
- Experience using CRM systems and Microsoft Office
- A proactive approach and the ability to work independently and as part of a team
- A stable employment history demonstrating commitment and reliability

What's In It For You?

We recognise that great people make great businesses. You will receive a competitive salary and benefits package, including:
- Life assurance
- Contributory pension scheme (5% employee contribution matched by ASD)
- Retail, restaurant, gym and health club discounts
- Holiday Trading Scheme
- Cycle to Work scheme
- Medicash healthcare plan
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Financial wellbeing support

Safety Comes First

Safety is at the heart of everything we do. All employees are subject to pre-employment and ongoing drug and alcohol testing. ASD operates a zero-tolerance policy.

Ready to Apply?

If you are ready to join a market-leading business and take your sales career to the next level, we would love to hear from you.

Apply online today and upload your latest CV.

Our application process takes just a few minutes before transferring you to our internal recruitment system.

title: TPS Parts Sales Executive
description:
We have an exciting new opportunity for a Parts Sales Executive to join our growing TPS business in Leeds.

Who are TPS?

TPS provides independent garages and bodyshops with the high-quality Genuine Parts and products which customers need to ensure they can service and repair Volkswagen Group vehicles. TPS is part of the Volkswagen Group along with Audi, SEAT, ŠKODA, Volkswagen passenger cars and Commercial Vehicles. TPS is a national network of TPS Centres with a 1,500-strong national workforce and a management team that prides itself on creating an environment that offers our people a motivating and inclusive workplace where they are recognised and rewarded and are encouraged to go on a journey of Learning and Development.

As a Parts Advisor you will be working with the Sales Manager and team to deliver excellent service to our Customers and achieve the sales objectives of the Centre

Parts interpretation & identification is a key element of this role, parts experience or motor mechanical knowledge would be an advantage but is not essential.

What are we looking for?
- A self-starter with a proven track record in building strong relationships and achieving sales targets in a B2 B environment
- Confident and capable communicator with proven experience of selling in a fast paced and/or telesales environment
- Passion for providing a great customer service experience
- Excellent communication skills both verbally and written with the ability to build strong relationships with all key stakeholders
- A team player with the drive and determination to achieve individual and sales targets on a weekly & monthly basis
- Excellent attention to detail and accurate record-keeping
- IT literate, preferably with a good working knowledge of MS Excel

What we can offer you:
- A genuine platform for you to develop your career and skills through our industry leading training and development programmes.
- A Volkswagen Group induction programme that provides you all of the knowledge for you to excel in the workplace
- An honest and trustworthy place of work with an opportunity to join an exceptionally knowledgeable team of industry professionals

Why Sytner?

Sytner Group are delighted to provide an industry-leading benefits package.

We are passionate about continuous improvement and building an environment where everyone feels valued, appreciated and able to reach their full potential.
- Enhanced Holiday Entitlement - 33 days inc. bank holidays
- Industry-leading Maternity, Paternity and Adoption Pay
- Career Development
- Recognition of Long Service every 5 years
- Discounted Car Schemes
- High Street Discounts
- Discounted Gym memberships
- Cycle to work scheme
- One day a year paid voluntary / community work

At Sytner, our values and the way we behave are important to us. We are committed to creating an equitable working environment where we value and respect every individual's unique contribution, supporting our colleagues to thrive and achieve their full potential.

As part of our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion, you have the right to ask for changes / adjustments to job interviews and the recruitment process. For more information around reasonable adjustments and the recruitment process please .

Unsure? Read on

We represent over 23 of the world's most prestige vehicle brands, across our 140 UK dealerships.

We pride ourselves on 'Developing Talent and 'Building Careers' and our colleagues recently scored Sytner Group an outstanding 89% on our colleague engagement survey.

title: Account Manager Paid Socials
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Paid Social Account Manager to join a Leeds-based creative business working with an impressive portfolio of household names across beauty, retail and FMCG.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a social media specialist who understands that effective social goes beyond content and clicks. Working as part of an insight-led team, you'll help clients connect social activity to wider brand strategy, audience engagement and commercial growth, bringing together paid, organic and influencer activity to deliver meaningful results.

The Role

You'll take ownership of the day-to-day management of a portfolio of client accounts, acting as a key point of contact and building strong, trusted relationships with clients.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing paid social campaigns across Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok and Pinterest, ensuring activity is aligned with client objectives and wider marketing strategies.
- Coordinating paid, organic and influencer activity to deliver cohesive, insight-led social campaigns.
- Acting as a primary client contact, presenting content plans, campaign ideas and performance reports, and providing strategic recommendations.
- Monitoring campaign performance against KPIs, analysing results and identifying opportunities to optimise activity and improve ROI.
- Briefing creative and studio teams on campaign assets, content requirements and creative development.
- Managing influencer relationships from initial research and selection through to campaign delivery and fulfilment.
- Attending client meetings and external photoshoots where required.
- Contributing research, audience insights and ideas to support client growth and new business opportunities.

You'll have the opportunity to take real ownership of your accounts, influence campaign direction and help clients understand how effective social activity can support their wider commercial ambitions.

About You

You'll have experience in a client-facing social media, paid social or digital marketing role, ideally within a creative, digital or integrated agency environment.

You'll bring:
- Around three years' experience in social media or digital marketing, with hands-on paid social campaign management experience.
- Practical experience using platforms such as Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, TikTok and Pinterest.
- Confidence managing client relationships, presenting ideas and communicating performance insights.
- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret campaign data and turn findings into actionable recommendations.
- Experience briefing creative teams and coordinating campaign delivery across multiple stakeholders.
- An understanding of how paid, organic and influencer activity can work together to achieve wider marketing objectives.
- A proactive, organised approach, with the confidence to manage competing priorities and take ownership of your accounts.

You'll be curious about what drives audience behaviour, comfortable working with data and passionate about delivering social campaigns that make a measurable difference.

The Package
- Salary: £30,000-£35,000, depending on experience
- Hybrid working
- 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays
- Enhanced pension
- Regular company socials
- Learning and development opportunities
